description: Shishya AstroCoders is a student-led team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge in Bangalore. We combine software development, space science, AI/ML, data analysis, and creative problem-solving to develop innovative solutions. We welcome passionate participants interested in coding, scientific research, design, data visualization, and space exploration. We value teamwork, curiosity, commitment, and collaboration. Join us to explore ideas, build solutions, and make an impact!
